biotools.summary: HTSinfer is a Python-based tool that infers metadata from bulk Illumina RNA-sequencing data. It leverages genome sequence information to accurately infer library characteristics and is released under the Apache License 2.0, with code available on GitHub and packages published on Bioconda.
